c2-immediately-after.title: Immediately After: -gach
c2-immediately-after.explanation: -gach marks one action as happening immediately upon the completion of another, tighter in sequence than the more neutral -gandan keyin: u kelgach, boshladik (as soon as he/she arrived, we started) implies almost no gap between the two events.
c2-immediately-after.fact: -gach is a converb that never takes a personal ending at all, unlike -gan (which does when used predicatively) -- it exists purely to glue one clause tightly to the next, with the sentence's real tense and person carried entirely by the final verb.

dialogue.en: As soon as you received the news, what did you do?
As soon as I received it, I called immediately.

c2-esa.title: Contrastive Topic: esa
c2-esa.explanation: Esa marks a shift in topic with an implied contrast, close to "as for X.../whereas": men choy ichaman, u esa qahva ichadi (I drink tea, whereas he/she drinks coffee). It highlights the new topic against what was just said, without needing a separate word for "but".
c2-esa.fact: Esa can also stand at the very start of a clause with no preceding contrast at all, simply to mark "now, about this..." when shifting attention to a new subject -- its contrastive reading comes from context, not from any built-in meaning of opposition.

dialogue.native: Men futbolni yoqtiraman, akam esa shaxmatni afzal ko'radi.
dialogue.en: I like football, whereas my older brother prefers chess.

c2-evidential-ekan.title: Mirative/Evidential: ekan
c2-evidential-ekan.explanation: Ekan marks information the speaker has just realized or learned indirectly, without the skepticism emish carries: u juda mehnatkash ekan (it turns out he/she is very hard-working) reports a fresh realization, treated as reliable, not doubted hearsay.
c2-evidential-ekan.fact: Ekan and emish both mark information not witnessed firsthand, but they split "apparently" into two flavors English doesn't distinguish grammatically: ekan for a neutral, credible discovery, emish for something the speaker is holding at arm's length -- choosing the wrong one subtly misrepresents how much the speaker actually believes it.

dialogue.en: What kind of person does he/she turn out to be?
He/she turns out to be very kind.

c2-poetic-yu.title: Elevated Coordination: -u / -yu
c2-poetic-yu.explanation: The enclitic -u (after a consonant) or -yu (after a vowel) links a pair into one vivid, often emotionally heightened image: kechayu kunduz (night and day, ceaselessly), yig'lay-yig'lay gapirdi is plain repetition, but kuni-yu tuni ishladi (he/she worked day and night) uses -u/-yu to fuse the pair into a single continuous stretch of time.
c2-poetic-yu.fact: This coordination is reserved for elevated or literary register -- swapping it for the plain conjunction va (kun va tun, "day and va night") is grammatically fine but strips out the sense of relentless, unbroken continuity that -u/-yu specifically signals.

dialogue.native: U bu loyiha ustida qanday ishladi?
dialogue.en: How did he/she work on this project?
He/she worked tirelessly, night and day.

c2-formal-passive-causative.title: Formal Register: Stacked Passive-Causative
c2-formal-passive-causative.explanation: Bureaucratic and legal Uzbek often stacks the causative and passive on one stem for an impersonal, formal tone: ko'rib chiqilishi so'raladi ("it is requested that [it] be reviewed") distances the sentence from any named actor entirely -- nobody is said to be doing or requesting anything, only that reviewing-of-it is being requested.
c2-formal-passive-causative.fact: This stacked, actor-erasing structure is essentially never used in casual speech -- reaching for it (rather than a plain active sentence with a named subject) is itself a register marker, signaling "this is an official document" the same way passive constructions do in formal English.

dialogue.en: When will the application be reviewed?
It is requested that it be reviewed within the established period.

items.en: As soon as he/she arrived, we started.
As soon as I received the news, I responded immediately.
As soon as the work was finished, we returned home.
As soon as the sun rose, we set off on the journey.
As soon as the exam ended, we all took a breath of relief.

items.uz: U gapini aytgach, hamma jim qoldi.
items.en: As soon as he/she said his/her piece, everyone fell silent.
As soon as the train arrived, passengers got ready to disembark.
As soon as the rain stopped, we went outside.
As soon as the letter arrived, I waited for a reply.

items.uz: U so'zlagach, hammaning ko'ziga yosh keldi.
items.en: As soon as he/she spoke, tears came to everyone's eyes.

items.uz: Kelishuv imzolangach, ikkala tomon ham xursand bo'ldi.
items.en: As soon as the agreement was signed, both sides were pleased.
As soon as I woke up, I immediately got to work.

items.uz: Men futbolni yoqtiraman, akam esa shaxmatni.
items.en: I like football, whereas my older brother likes chess.

items.uz: Bugun issiq, ertaga esa sovuq bo'ladi.
items.en: Today it's hot, whereas tomorrow it will be cold.

items.uz: U shaharda, men esa qishloqda yashayman.
items.en: He/she lives in the city, whereas I live in the countryside.

items.uz: Onam choy ichadi, dadam esa qahva.
items.en: My mother drinks tea, whereas my father drinks coffee.

items.uz: Birinchi savol oson, ikkinchisi esa qiyin edi.
items.en: The first question was easy, whereas the second was difficult.

items.uz: U kelishga rozi, men esa hali ikkilanaman.
items.en: He/she agrees to come, whereas I'm still hesitant.

items.uz: Bu yil yomg'ir kam, o'tgan yili esa juda ko'p edi.
items.en: This year rain is scarce, whereas last year there was a lot.

items.uz: Ular shaharga ko'chib ketishdi, biz esa qoldik.
items.en: They moved to the city, whereas we stayed.

items.uz: Men kitob o'qishni yaxshi ko'raman, u esa film ko'rishni.
items.en: I love reading books, whereas he/she loves watching movies.

items.uz: Bu masala oson, keyingisi esa ancha murakkab.
items.en: This issue is easy, whereas the next one is quite complex.

items.uz: U tez orada keladi, men esa biroz kechikaman.
items.en: He/she will come soon, whereas I'll be a bit late.

items.uz: Bahor yaqinlashmoqda, qish esa asta orqaga chekinmoqda.
items.en: Spring is approaching, whereas winter is slowly retreating.
It turns out he/she is very hard-working.
It turns out this problem is actually easy.

items.uz: U ko'pdan beri shu yerda yashar ekan.
items.en: It turns out he/she has been living here for a long time.
It turns out this book is very interesting.
It turns out he/she is younger than me.

items.uz: Bu yerda ajoyib manzaralar bor ekan.
items.en: It turns out there are wonderful views here.

items.uz: U bu haqda hammasini bilar ekan.
items.en: It turns out he/she knows everything about this.
It turns out the weather is very nice today.

items.uz: Bu ish aslida ancha murakkab ekan.
items.en: It turns out this task is actually quite complex.
It turns out he/she has always been this humble.
It turns out this road is quite long.
It turns out he/she hadn't forgotten us at all.
He/she worked tirelessly, night and day.
They spent day and night thinking of each other.

items.uz: Yozu qish bir xil mehnat qildi.
items.en: He/she worked the same, summer and winter.
He/she was on the road, early and late.
Far and near, he/she informed everyone.
We spent bitter and sweet days together.

items.uz: Ko'z yoshi-yu kulgi aralash o'tgan bir kun edi.
items.en: It was a day mixed with tears and laughter.

items.uz: Qish-u yoz bir xil mehr bilan kutib oldi.
items.en: Winter and summer, he/she welcomed with the same warmth.
He/she remembered long years and short moments.

items.uz: Yaxshi-yu yomon kunlarni birga bosib o'tdik.
items.en: We went through good and bad days together.

items.uz: Tog'u tosh kezib, izlanishda davom etdi.
items.en: Roaming mountains and rocks, he/she continued the search.

items.uz: Sovuq-u issiqqa qaramay, yo'lida davom etdi.
items.en: Regardless of cold and heat, he/she continued on his/her way.
It is requested that the application be reviewed.
The documents are required to be submitted.
This matter needs to be clarified.
It is required that the established order not be violated.
The decision needs to be delivered to the relevant authority.
The fulfillment of all requirements is monitored.
This information is required to be kept confidential.

items.uz: Xato tuzatilishi va qayta yuborilishi so'raladi.
items.en: It is requested that the error be corrected and resent.
The meeting minutes need to be signed.

items.uz: Ushbu qoida hamma tomonidan bajarilishi shart.
items.en: This rule is required to be followed by everyone.

items.uz: Natijalar rasmiy ravishda e'lon qilinishi kutilmoqda.
items.en: The results are expected to be officially announced.
It is required that the project's completion on schedule be ensured.
